alt.en: Chapter 02, "The next 30 days", on the week of 14 to 20 November 2026: the resort filters, the key and the weeks to page through at the top, the "Best park" row under the days, then 16 rows for the Disney, Universal and SeaWorld parks and the day trips, most with one square per day for the peak wait, the crowd level and the hours.

caption.en: On 20 November, Animal Kingdom gets the frame at 45, not Magic Kingdom at 40, because Magic Kingdom closes at 6 pm that evening for the party.
